# anthropic_organization (Data Source)

The organization the configured credential belongs to. Works with any credential class.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_organization" "current" {}

output "organization_id" {
  value = data.anthropic_organization.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization id (UUID).
- `name` (String) Organization name.
